scope: Exact application PCM queue capture/restore and batched pump prerequisite for native audio snapshots
status: queue primitive implemented in original CPAL callback path; AudioSession native snapshot integration remains open
dependency: crossbeam-queue =0.3.14 from cached source; reuse ArrayQueue, no new unsafe queue implementation

checks.clippy: audio_device and editor all-targets -D warnings passed
checks.format: scoped rustfmt and diff check passed

verified: Original CPAL callback consumes bounded ArrayQueue via exact shared receiver path; no callback mutex or allocation added
Unique RAII freeze excludes new producer/callback operations and polls in-flight completion without waiting
Capture rotates only quiescent queue, retaining allocation, sender identity and exact PCM ordering
Checkpoint stores sample bits, including negative zero/subnormal; bounded preparation rejects malformed PCM/capacity before publication
Replacement returns exact old queue for outer rollback; mismatched/failed candidates leave source intact
Cancellation during in-flight operation resumes same queue without discarding frame; closed queue cannot be resurrected
720 callback continuation composes queued PCM with original PcmPump unsent suffix
Batched PcmPump matches original single-frame algorithm for 720 irregular callbacks at capacities 1/5/128, including cursor, renderer clock and PCM bits
Batch submission validation/backpressure prefixes match original single-frame semantics for active/frozen/closed queues
Concurrent producer/callback stress and repeated capture/replace preserve every expected sample in order

performance.limitation: Single-frame API is slower than former reference; production PcmPump now batches. No claim all submission forms are faster, no hardware or FPS claim

limitations: No physical audio device, native window or GPU benchmark run
Queue checkpoint covers application PCM only, not host buffers or playback position/rate
OutputQueueCheckpoint is an in-memory typed record; persistent outer archive composition remains open
Unique freeze token intentionally supplies silence if callback is invoked; real native checkpoint must pair it with native pause acknowledgement
AudioSession Native checkpoint guard remains unchanged and verified by full editor tests
Frame pacing, audible continuity, latency and power need actual-device qualification
